author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇦🇷🇺🇳 @JMilei took to the UN podium and proceeded to absolutely unload… on the UN itself. 🤣

He called the organization “useless” and accused it of feeding a “caste of fatally arrogant parasites disguised as well-intentioned bureaucrats.”

An institution meant to protect security and human rights has instead failed, while “chaos, violence and international terrorism” have flourished.

Going to the UN to tell the UN it’s useless... boss move

Writer: Lynn
